The objective is to lease, install, and maintain an integrated security system for the Ak-Chin Community Health Clinic that can be maintained at the Phoenix Indian Medical Center. The system should include a remotely monitored alarm system, surveillance cameras, and associated monitoring and support services. The leased system will enhance the security and safety of facilities, personnel, and visitors, and safeguard federally owned property by providing continuous monitoring, timely detection of security incidents, and responsive support services in accordance with applicable federal standards, policies, and requirements
